blocks.text: Yeh chapter computer networks se ta'aruf karata hai: devices kaise jore jate hain aur aapas mein kaise baat karte hain. Is mein network architecture aur us ka bunyadi kaam, networks ki bari qismein, networking devices (NIC, switch, router, modem aur access point), topologies, OSI model, aam protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP aur DNS), IP addressing, subnetting aur NAT, ghar ka network banana aur Wi-Fi ki hifazat, ping aur ipconfig jaise diagnostic commands, aur aakhir mein network ki karkardagi (performance), security, backup aur asani aur hifazat ke darmiyan tawazun shamil hain.

blocks.title: Computer network
blocks.text: Computer network jure hue computers aur doosre devices ka group hai jo data, wasail (resources) aur services share karne ke liye aapas mein baat karte hain.

Network mukhtalif devices ko jorne aur baat karne deta hai, is liye maloomat tezi aur asani se share hoti hain aur waqt aur mehnat bachti hai. Networks computers, mobile phones, printers aur doosre digital devices ko jor sakte hain (Fig 1.1). Devices cables ya wireless signals se baat karte hain, aur data, files aur resources aik device se doosre tak jate hain. Zaroorat ke mutabiq networks chhote ya bare ho sakte hain, aur yeh gharon, schools, daftaron aur karobar mein use hote hain; aaj ki zindagi in par bohat munhasir (dependent) hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein Wi-Fi lehron wala wireless router, jo tooti lakeeron (dashed lines) se desktop computer, laptop, monitor, printer, mobile phone, folder, cloud, music aur video ke nishan se jura hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Networks online parhai aur ghar se kaam (remote work) mumkin banate hain, aur karobar rozana ke kaam ke liye networks par inhisar karte hain.

items: Internet browsing network ke istemal ki sab se aam misal hai.
Mobile phones calls, messages aur apps ke liye networks use karte hain.
Schools online classes aur learning systems ke liye networks use karte hain.
Banks online transactions aur ATMs ke liye networks use karte hain.
Social media platforms computer networks ke zariye chalte hain.
Smart ghar devices control karne ke liye networks use karte hain.
